resources.string: Shows the current lyric line, in sync with the song. Follows your system colors.
Album art with previous, play/pause and next controls. Follows your system colors.
Lyrics aren\'t time-synced — open Felicity to read them
Frosted-glass player card over blurred album art, with previous, play/pause and next.
Frosted-glass lyrics widget over blurred album art, following the current line.
Square album art with a floating frosted-glass title strip and play/pause button.
A slim Material You pill with art, title, play/pause and next. Follows your system colors.
The next songs in your queue, with play/pause and next. Follows your system colors.
A slim frosted-glass now-playing bar with art, title and previous, play/pause, next.
Frosted-glass queue: the song playing now and the next three, with play/pause and next.
A record-style disc with the album art as its label. A glowing rim shows when it is playing.
